meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: Claude 会把你的 claude-mem 观察记录筛选、编译成专门的知识库,加载进一个 AI 会话后,你可以像聊天一样向它提问,追问会保留上下文。
howto.when: 当你想从观察历史里建一个专题知识库、询问过去的工作模式,或汇编某个主题的经验时,它会接管。

say.text: 帮我建一个知识库,主题是 hooks 生命周期,项目为 claude-mem
say.note: 触发 build_corpus 并按条件筛选

say.text: 加载 hooks 知识库,然后告诉我 5 个生命周期钩子分别何时触发
say.note: 先 prime,再 query_corpus 提问

say.text: 列出我现有的所有知识库,带上统计和加载状态

howto.what_en: Claude filters your claude-mem observations into focused knowledge bases and primes them into an AI session. You can then ask questions conversationally, and follow-ups keep their context.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to build a focused brain from your observation history, ask about past work patterns, or compile expertise on a specific topic.

say_en.text: Build a corpus named hooks-expertise covering hooks in the claude-mem project
Prime hooks-expertise, then tell me when each of the 5 lifecycle hooks fires
say_en.note: Primes the corpus, then runs query_corpus.

say_en.text: List all my corpora with their stats and priming status
